title: Promote automatically; early on accept unless clearly worse
description: A revision that evaluates better on held-out recent votes is promoted automatically, logged and revertible. While samples cannot tell the versions apart, accept the new revision unless the evidence says it is clearly worse; once there is enough data, it must show improvement. Enough comes from the statistics, not a constant. staged_optimization.py already does this for the first rubric and provisional refinements; extend it to the classifier, whose min_development_per_class=20 in classifier_training.py holds promotion today, and to later rubric proposals held as 'waiting for adequate development class coverage'. Coverage is the real constraint: Anth.us has about 4 rejections in 75 votes. Keep the sibling check: a change must not quietly regress another output.
